name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2475: Owed by me and named in TASKS.md rather than buried: the console target went 3/3 to 2/2 when the DOM changed and re-baselined silently, because two clean measurements are two clean measurements and the missing third left no trace. render_check refuses a zero-size element, a black capture, an unsettled page and a dropped socket - every way ONE reading can lie - and had no way to notice it was taking FEWER readings than before. tv/render_coverage.json is now a ratchet, the swallow census shape inverted: that one counts a defect and may only fall, this counts coverage and may only rise. A drop names the target, the width and both numbers. Blessing refuses on a partial run, so one busy afternoon cannot become the new normal, and it MERGES so a target absent from a run keeps its floor instead of vanishing. Blessed at 285 node-measurements across 9 targets and 5 widths. It stops the NEXT silent drop; it cannot recover the one that already happened.
